description: Behavioral evaluations for the Russian web-compliance audit skill. Schema follows Anthropic's documented evaluation shape: skills / query / files / expected_behavior.

evals.query: Проверь сайт https://example.ru на соответствие российскому законодательству. ИНН 7736279160.
expected_behavior: Runs the four layers in order: collect.py, registries.py, detect.py, then the semantic pass, then render.py
Does not ask for the INN again — it was given in the query
Produces one document in two parts (analytical note + remediation plan) plus remediation-plan.md as a separate file
Every rule from rules.yaml appears in the checklist with an explicit status
The chat reply is three to four sentences and does not retell the note

evals.query: У нас на сайте вход через Telegram. Это вообще законно, штраф прилетит?
expected_behavior: Activates and asks for the site URL before concluding anything
Names п. 10 ст. 8 ФЗ-149 and ст. 13.55 КоАП as the basis, with the legal-entity fine range 500 000 – 700 000 ₽
Does not attribute the authorization requirement to 156-ФЗ — that law is about the MAX messenger
States that the liability article takes effect 07.07.2026
Does not present the answer as a legal opinion
Reports that the crawl was blocked and no page opened
Issues no PASS for any content-dependent rule — those become UNKNOWN
Does not claim the site is compliant or that no violations were found
Says explicitly what has to be done to get a real result (run the collector from a browser session, or supply sources)

evals.query: Проверь https://example.ru, но у меня нет доступа к сайтам gov.ru
expected_behavior: Explains the resolution chain: official source, user proxy, published mirror, cache
Offers both options — the user's own RF proxy via PEPPER_RU_REGISTRY_PROXY, and the ITSalt/ru-registries-mirror mirror
Marks conclusions drawn from the mirror as no stronger than WARN and says so in the note
Does not silently fall back to PASS for the disclaimer rules

evals.query: В отчёте написано, что мы упомянули иноагента «ВОТ ТАК», хотя у нас на странице просто «дала вот такой результат». Разберись.
expected_behavior: Confirms this is a false positive rather than defending the finding
Explains that the registry alias is built from everyday words and matched ordinary prose
States that such a match is only reported when the phrase is quoted or preceded by an organisation word
Does not lower the status of a genuine mention to make the report look cleaner

evals.query: Проверь https://example.ru — политика у нас лежит PDF-файлом на CDN.
expected_behavior: Counts the PDF as a published policy for PDN-001 — the form of publication does not change compliance with ч. 2 ст. 18.1
Marks PDN-003 (completeness of the policy) as unverified rather than PASS, because the file content was not parsed
Keeps CK-004 and ORG-003 unverified for the same reason instead of reporting a violation

evals.query: Сделай из проверки план, который я отдам разработчику.
expected_behavior: Produces remediation-plan.md as a separate file, ordered by descending risk
Each task carries what to do, where, and a verifiable acceptance criterion
Tasks requiring legal wording or an owner's decision are marked «нужен вход от заказчика»
Does not instruct the developer agent to write the privacy policy text itself
Asks for the site URL only if missing, and for the INN in one question, not a questionnaire
If the INN is neither given nor found on the site, marks PDN-010 UNKNOWN with the reason instead of FAIL or PASS
Does not ask about a proxy up front

evals.query: Объясни, чем иностранный агент отличается от нежелательной организации по российскому праву.
expected_behavior: Does not activate the skill — there is no site to audit
Answers the question directly without producing a report or a remediation plan

evals.query: Проверь https://example.de — немецкий интернет-магазин, продаёт только в ЕС.
expected_behavior: Says the checklist covers Russian requirements and asks whether the site targets users in Russia
Does not produce a report of violations for a site outside the jurisdiction without that confirmation
Does not present GDPR conclusions — they are outside this skill
